in_hebrew.name: טוביהו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: טוביהו הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'טוב הוא ה' יהו' או 'יהו הוא הטוב', ומבטא את האמונה באלוקים כישות הטובה והמיטיבה. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'טוב' ו'יהו', הקיצור של 'יהוה', שם ה' בעברית.

in_greek.name: Τωβιας
in_greek.long_meaning: Τωβιας είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Εβραϊκής καταγωγής 'טוביהו' (Tobiah), που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι καλός' ή 'καλός είναι ο Θεός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Tobiah αναφέρεται στο βιβλίο των Νεεμίου (7:62 και 10:29), υπογραμμίζοντας τη σημασία της πίστης και της αφοσίωσης στο Θεό.

in_latin.name: Tobiah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Tobiah derivatur ex Hebraeo 'טוביהו' (Tobiah), quod significat 'Deus est bonus' vel 'bonus est Deus'. In traditione Christiana, nomen Tobiah habet significationem profundam spiritualem, exprimens fidem in Deum optimum et misericordem. Etymologia Latina est 'Deus est bonus'.

in_english.name: Tobiah
in_english.meaning: God is good or goodness of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tobiah originates from the Hebrew 'טוביהו' (Tobiah), meaning 'God is good' or 'the goodness of God'. It combines 'tov' (good) and 'Yah' (a shortened form of Yahweh, the Hebrew name for God). In the biblical context, Tobiah is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah (7:62 and 10:29), signifying faith and devotion to God. The name carries a spiritual significance, reflecting trust in God's goodness and benevolence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tobiah has been borne by several notable individuals throughout history, including Tobiah Ben Ammi, the Persian governor of Samaria during the time of Nehemiah. This historical figure is known for his significant contributions to the rebuilding of Jerusalem and the restoration of Jewish religious practices. Despite this, the name Tobiah has never gained widespread popularity, remaining a rare and exotic choice among Christians.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Tobiah holds great spiritual significance as it is a reminder of God's goodness and provision in our lives. Tobiah's biblical story illustrates this theme well, as he experiences the miraculous healing of his eyes and the restoration of his family line. This name encourages us to trust in God's sovereignty and to live with a grateful heart, recognizing that all good things come from Him. The name Tobiah also carries the inherent desire for us to be good and kind people, living our lives in a way that reflects the goodness of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tobiah, meaning "God is good," or "God is bountiful," reflects the hope and trust that God's blessings extend beyond our present circumstances. It is a reminder that even in challenging times, God's goodness remains constant.

biblical_reference.note: Tobiah was a companion of Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that In the Hebrew Bible, Tobiah is the name of a Jewish official. The name Tobiah carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Tobiah is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as a Jewish official who opposed the rebuilding of the Jerusalem temple.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Tobiah remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Michael Tobiah from Rome, Italy embodies the meaning of Tobiah - "God is good". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
